prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL full-width pixel-art underwater natural pond game environment, first-round TERRAIN AND LARGE COMPOSITION study for new map M01 STONE SHELF BAY, variant A. The user's supplied pond illustrations are STYLE REFERENCES only: borrow deliberate pixel clusters, blue-green underwater depth, olive silt, layered low-contrast far banks and soft shafts, not any exact composition. Produce one 2048x768 panorama (8:3); no panels, labels, text, UI, borders or characters. Orthographic side-view game background, not isometric, not realistic painting. Crisp stepped silhouettes and coherent medium-sized pixel clusters, avoid photographic texture/noisy confetti. This stage includes ONLY water, lighting, bare sediment terrain, large stones and a small dead stump. NO vegetation, moss, leaves, hanging living roots, fish, shrimp, snails or other fauna. Terrain must be natural weathered pond rock shelves, not human stairs, masonry, tiled rectangles or repeated geological stripes. Variant A massing: one dominant old fractured rock shoulder at LEFT edge, x0-27%, with just TWO unequal broad irregular shelves, highest lip y54% at far left descending to y77% by x27%. Sloping sunlit sediment apron gradually opens into a broad shallow pale-silt bay, spanning x30-82%, ground at y87-92%; the lowest area is around x64%. Right bank is very low, rises to y81% only at far right. A single short split weathered stump at x90%, top y74%, partly buried and clearly subordinate; no long log bridge. Stones clustered by the left shoulder, sparse in center. Large clean continuous water band x28-83%, y14-70% MUST stay free of solid silhouettes. Dark foreground only in tiny lower corners, no full-width high wall. Backdrop contains dim blue-teal broken shelves receding into depth near far margins, no periodic wave profiles or symmetric bumps. Underwater shafts enter from upper right, soft broad and low contrast behind gameplay space. Upper surface thin, no lily pads yet. Muted green-grey weathered rock, warm dull ochre silt, teal water. Finished pixel-art terrain art-direction plate with intentional space for later communities, no ecological details yet.
